summary: Participants debate whether to enforce NaN/Inf restrictions, whether to separate finite vectors from fixed‑length lists, and how best to express these constraints without changing the underlying physical storage. The consensus leans toward a logical type that can be read by multiple engines while keeping implementation complexity manageable. 1.19.0 Manu proposes a patch release of Parquet Java 1.18.2 to include several critical fixes and dependency updates. The community, including Fokko and Steve, supports the release and is ready to review the backport PRs.
